comparison.objective: Mix flour and liquid into dough while steadying a loose bowl.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual bowl stabilization and spoon stirring through granular material.
comparison.success_condition: At least 95% mixed, with limited spill and bowl tilt.
comparison.reason: Tests distributed mixing and spill control rather than precision unlocking, rotary tuning, torque-limited relocking, and repeated impact evaluation.
